title: fix(deps): drop the banned rhachet-brains-fireworksai peer dependency
description:
## .what
rhachet-roles-bhuild declares rhachet-brains-fireworksai as a peer (and dev) dependency. fireworks is a banned brain provider. a consumer that removed fireworks from its own package.json still installs it: pnpm why lists it as a peer of rhachet-roles-bhuild@0.21.37.

## .why
- every consumer install pulls a banned provider it neither declares nor imports
- related: #444 (REFLECT_BRAIN_SLUG names a fireworks slug no brains package registers); that is the slug half, this is the dependency half

## .shape of the fix
- drop rhachet-brains-fireworksai from peer and dev dependencies
- move any default brain slug that names fireworks to a versionless openrouter tier slug
- release; consumers then bump bhuild and the transitive edge disappears

caught in ehmpathy/rhachet-roles-bhrain .dream/v2026_10_13.reseed.rhachet-roles-bhuild-still-peers-the-banned-fireworks-brain.md
